architecture: GMA control plane plus pinned public Hugging Face data plane and federated downstream consumers
boundaries: no durable local data lake required
MBS service and medicine dimensions remain independent
public release and consequential interpretations remain human gates
decision: Open Platinum as a production track after the Australian Silver/Gold and public-data contracts, rather than leaving later layers as roadmap-only sketches.

contract: Logical product resources require caller-supplied independently admitted v4 digests and exact offline-reconciled distribution bindings. Resolution preserves dataset, revision, path, SHA-256, bytes, source/acquisition/layer, semantic dimension and entity granularity. Reads reuse anonymous public/non-gated verification, byte/time/open-result/cache bounds, explicit exact-digest offline cache behavior and eviction.
boundaries: No live Hub access in tests
No durable local lake or named cache
No DuckDB or Polars engine promotion
No deployment, publication, visibility mutation, credential use or production-readiness claim
